{{Quote|This parchment scroll supposedly contains the rambling meditations of Kooroo, an ancient sage and holy visionary who subscribed to a long-forgotten, mystical religion.|Nibao Glumm|<ref name="Gamer7" />}}
The '''Teachings of Kooroo''' was a scroll of parchment that supposedly contained the [[Meditation/Legends|meditations]] of [[Kooroo (being)|Kooroo]], an ancient sage and visionary<ref name="Gamer7" /> whom the cult known as the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]] considered its spiritual leader.<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> [[Nibao Glumm]], a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] on<ref name="Gamer7" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], characterized Kooroo's meditations as "rambling."<ref name="Gamer7" />

At some point by [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}} states that the Teachings of Kooroo was held in [[Shiin's Library]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the latter of which was established in [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]], according to ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''.</ref> the scroll had found its way into the private collection of the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Shiin]], which she held in a [[Shiin's Library|library]] in Mos Eisley. All of the artifacts in Shiin's [[Library/Legends|library]], including the Teachings of Kooroo, had been imaged and logged into the local [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system before being locked in an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] vault.<ref name="Gamer7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Teachings of Kooroo was mentioned in the article "[[Secrets of Mos Eisley]]," which was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and published in [[Star Wars Gamer 7|''Star Wars Gamer'' 7]]<ref name="Gamer7" /> on [[October 16]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011018.html|text=Live on the Fringe: ''Gamer'' # 7}}</ref>
